correctnessFindings.assessment: Empty glyph results are moved to dedicated numeric and combined-key caches with a shared 4096-entry count. A new empty result at capacity clears both empty caches before insertion; ordinary visible glyph atlas storage is unchanged.
Lookup still returns the existing NULL_RASTERIZED_GLYPH sentinel. Texture/page reset clears the empty caches too, including the early no-pages path.
The source patch, emitted browser bundles, and pnpm patch hash carry the same change. Evicted entries are derived rasterization results and can be recomputed from the retained terminal cells.

originalReview.userVisibleBeforeAfter: Terminal text, colors, scrollback, and visible glyphs remain unchanged. Repeatedly cycling more than 4096 distinct empty glyph keys can cause extra empty-glyph rasterization work.
originalReview.capacityAndDataLoss: The 4096 bound applies to derived empty-glyph cache entries only. It does not drop terminal data or restrict accepted colors or characters.

platformEvidence.assessment: The patch targets shared xterm WebGL JavaScript. The historical browser reproduction uses headless Chromium/SwiftShader and two terminals sharing an atlas, not native GPU drivers on all three operating systems.
platformEvidence.executedHost: Fresh shared batch: macOS darwin arm64; Node 26.6.0. PRs outside that batch have no new execution in this follow-up.

originalReview.sshAndFolderCases: Rendering remote output uses the same atlas; no wire format, execution host, or folder-workspace behavior changes.

regressionCoverage.description: The historical artifact exercises 100000 color/space and joined-space keys, checks the 4096 cache bound, stable page counts, live A/B pixel hashes, and hot-key reuse. Source patch and emitted integration were reviewed; no fresh graphical run was launched.
